description: This file defines MongoDB repository classes for user, conversation, feedback, and document data, including a bundle class to aggregate these repositories. It uses asynchronous database operations with Motor and type annotations.

classes.name: _UsersMongo
classes.description: MongoDB implementation of user repository, handling user creation and retrieval.

classes.name: _ConversationsMongo
classes.description: MongoDB implementation of conversation repository, handling adding conversations.

classes.name: _FeedbackMongo
classes.description: MongoDB implementation of feedback repository, handling adding audit logs.

classes.name: _DocumentsMongo
classes.description: MongoDB implementation of document metadata repository, handling adding document info.

classes.name: MongoRepoBundle
classes.description: A class that aggregates all individual MongoDB repositories into a single bundle for easier access.

methods.name: create_stub_if_missing
methods.description: Creates a user stub if a user with the given username does not exist, setting default language and creation timestamp.

methods.name: add_conversation
methods.description: Adds a new conversation document to the 'conversations' collection and returns the inserted ID.

methods.name: add_audit_log
methods.description: Adds an audit log document to the 'audit_logs' collection and returns the inserted ID.

methods.name: add_document_meta
methods.description: Adds document metadata to the 'documents' collection and returns the inserted ID.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the repository classes with a MongoDB database connection.
